cpu_diagnostic.scope: One bounded existing-binary pair taskset -c0, no production affinity change. Exit0 from taskset; observer affinity field describes observer parent, not target. Underlying binaries are the corresponding retained direct artifacts, although binary_sha256 in these two wrapper records hashes /usr/bin/taskset.
cpu_diagnostic.interpretation: Large unpinned graph slowdown1.85–2.04x fell to1.33x on CPU0. Hybrid placement contributes but does not remove regression; no algorithm cause isolated.

findings: All28 HTTP semantic fixture pairs agree; three direct pairs×two workload last replies agree. Identity and volatile provider timing exclusions match foundation receipt.
Polling removal resolves old20msHTTP floor. Small science medians20.12/20.24ms→0.484/0.642ms. No claim that all this gain is kernel speed.
Small direct invocation improves144/194us→63.5/61.3us, while largegraph regresses4.08/4.00ms→7.54/8.15ms; CPU0 residual slowdown retained.
Thermal prepared+preparation batches are faster for all declared chains in observed trials, with analytic temperatures/power and fresh agreement. No HTTP or physical applicability claim.

Sequence prepared-first timings look worse; fresh-first timings reverse the ranking. The second alternative is much faster in both orders. These observations do not resolve a stable prepared-vs-stateless speed claim. Both exact pages/identity/cursors/work and naive scan agree.
Reader probes show concrete cache hits and retained-byte reservations, but also many intermediate plan compilations. Outer retained reservations returned to0 after every measured read.

Selected release reader deadline diagnostic had0errors in15one-second measured calls and5five-second measured calls on original fixed image. This does not replace full retained100+16cells or establish stable1s behavior of debug/deployed variants.
limitations: Shared machine load/CPU frequency, hybrid core placement, OS cache, allocator layout and monitoring are not isolated. Raw load before/after retained.
RSS stat counters are approximate; PSS/private smaps read at different instants, so separate sampled maxima need not order consistently. Child-walk nominal2ms wait can still miss peaks.
Consumer microbenchmarks use cancellation-only AtomicBool WorkControl, not production ExecutionContext fuel/deadline charging. No host throughput inference.

Original sequence pass kept first output alive during second timing and did large JSON/naive checks between paired trials. Counterbalanced same-binary followup exposes a strong order/cache/allocator confound; no cherry-picked replacement or causal API ratio.
Thermal numerical fields are compared with stated relative2e-7 tolerance; prepared results intentionally omit fresh factorization diagnostics. Analytic original-node balances independently checked.
Reader retained-byte units are conservative explicit reservations, not allocator live bytes or RSS. Returned wire strings and foreign/SQLite/mmap storage are outside this accounting.

The five deadline-sensitive cases were selected from prior failures and are diagnostic, not representative coverage. Earlier central validator DEV1s errors remain valid evidence; release observations do not erase them.
No new full reader four-cell/cohort or shipped specialist panels rerun by this measurement lane.
